description: Brew fantasy potion names — 'Elixir of Ember Sight' — each with a one-line magical effect.

faqs.a: Potion names are built from evocative patterns, and every one ships with a short magical effect description.
8 potions per click, all unique in the batch.
Click any potion to copy its name and effect.

howto: Read each name and its effect.
Click any potion to copy it.
title: Potion Name Generator
